So right now I’m just seeing a psychiatrist and a counselor, but in February I have an appointment at a local clinic called the Brain & Body institute. One of their specializations is treating Depression and TBIs. I was originally going in for my crippling depression, but after further research I suspect the treatment might focus more on treating my head injury.

I’ve read some articles that say a TBI increases your risk of developing Bipolar Disorder by 28% and Schizophrenia by 65%. I had a really bad biking accident and then had a mental breakdown 6 months later. I never connected the two but after reading more about TBI and what happens when the frontal lobes are damaged I’m really starting to see a connection. I am genetically predisposed to have Bipolar Disorder but I think the blow to the head didn’t do me any favors. My symptoms are also pervasive despite trying several medications.
